purpose: Repeat the frozen Stage36 consensus-objective screen after removing MD-start mean offsets from pocket features so that structural states represent shared dynamic deviations rather than starting-conformer identity.
trigger: Stage36 independently confirmed that the original Ward states produced zero cross-start threshold-consensus variation in all three cohorts.

state_representation.operation: subtract each MD start's 150-frame feature mean from every standardized pocket-feature vector, remove zero-variance residual features, rescale residual features to unit variance across all 1200 frames, then run frozen Ward clustering
state_representation.biological_interpretation: clusters represent recurrent directions of pocket motion relative to each start rather than absolute crystallographic offsets

interpretation_boundary: Stage36b can determine whether start-centered dynamic pocket states make the already frozen Stage36 consensus objectives nondegenerate and reproducibly difficult for strong greedy search. Passing authorizes a separately frozen sparse-QUBO encoding study, not docking, hardware, speedup, or quantum-advantage claims.
